hanoi.task:
Tower of Hanoi. Move every disk to peg C. Move one disk at a time, only the top disk of a peg, and never put a bigger disk on a smaller one. Disks are numbers (bigger number = bigger disk); each peg is listed bottom to top.
4 disks.
A: [4, 3, 2, 1]
B: []
C: []
Solve it using the move_disk tool, one move per call.
Before each move_disk call, write one short sentence saying why this move is right.
